name: ArcGIS StoryMaps
description: embeds ArcGIS StoryMaps with configurable settings.
project_description:
Embed ArcGIS StoryMaps in Drupal sites using a configurable block and admin settings.

 Admin Configuration: 
 
 Settings page at /admin/config/services/arcgis-storymaps 
 Site administrators can set the Story ID and root node selector 
 
 Custom Block: 
 
 Outputs the ArcGIS StoryMaps embed script using configured values 
 Can be placed via block layout or referenced in content types (e.g., with the Block Field module) 
 
 How to Use: 
 
 Enable the module 
 Configure Story ID and root node in the admin settings 
 Place the block or reference it in your content types 
 Back to top
